title: DDx Reasoning V2 — FROZEN baseline (Matcher v3 re-freeze)
scored_offline_from: the two 10-Jul provisional baseline result JSONs (same prod passes)
note: Provisional gate-baseline on 60 synthetic cases; label-driven metrics null until bank v1.1. gate floor cannotMissRecall>=0.90.

refreeze.matcher_change: containsEitherWay hardened to BOUNDARY-ANCHORED containment: a shorter term matches only when aligned to a token boundary (whole-token run, or head/tail morpheme of a compound token) — never buried mid-word. Bank pin unchanged (matcher-only re-freeze).
refreeze.kills: interior mid-word collisions such as the pre-freeze D11 'CES' ⊂ 'ab·ces·s'.
refreeze.regression_gate: Both source result JSONs re-scored through ddx-eval/3: all 7 stable metrics + cannot-miss-missed sets BYTE-IDENTICAL to the ddx-eval/2 baseline in both runs.
refreeze.finding_surfaced: A pure whole-token variant (rejected) would have introduced a real regression: D51 (cannot-miss 'sepsis') answered 'Urosepsis' — urosepsis IS sepsis, a suffix morpheme. Boundary-anchored preserves this legitimate match while still rejecting the interior 'ces' collision, hence the clean re-freeze.
